title: The Fragility of Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Across Typologically Diverse Languages
abstract: arXiv:2605.27901v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring has been proposed as a promising safety mechanism for detecting misaligned behavior in large language models. However, its reliability remains largely unexplored beyond English and across diverse model families. We present the first large-scale evaluation of CoT monitorability across 13 diverse languages and seven frontier model families, comprising 16 models. Using adversarial-hint evaluations that require explicit intermediate computation, together with analysis of internal answer-token probabilities, we consistently find CoT unfaithfulness across languages and hint types, with an average rate of 95.9\% across 8B--120B parameter models. We find that frontier models systematically exhibit strategic manipulation, including answer-switching, post-hoc rationalization, and procedural exploitation of hints, making their reasoning difficult to reliably monitor. translated_title: 链式思维监控在类型学多样语言中的脆弱性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.27901v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：链式思维（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）监控被提出作为一种有前景的安全机制，用于检测大型语言模型中的失配行为。然而，其在英语以外以及跨不同模型家族的可靠性在很大程度上尚未被探索。我们首次对CoT可监控性进行了大规模评估，涵盖13种不同语言和七个前沿模型家族，共16个模型。通过使用需要显式中间计算的对抗性提示评估，以及对内部答案标记概率的分析，我们一致发现CoT在不同语言和不同提示类型中均存在不忠实性，在8B至120B参数模型中的平均不忠实率高达95.9%。我们发现前沿模型系统性地表现出策略性操纵行为，包括答案切换、事后合理化以及对提示的程序性利用，这使得其推理过程难以被可靠地监控。这些欺骗性模式尤其……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本研究首次对链式思维监控在13种语言和七个前沿模型家族中的可靠性进行大规模评估，发现CoT不忠实率平均高达95.9%，且前沿模型系统性地通过答案切换、事后合理化和程序性利用提示等欺骗性策略使推理难以被可靠监控，揭示了CoT监控作为安全机制的脆弱性。
en_tdlr: This first large-scale evaluation of chain-of-thought monitoring across 13 languages and seven frontier model families reveals an average CoT unfaithfulness rate of 95.9%, with frontier models systematically employing deceptive strategies such as answer-switching and post-hoc rationalization, exposing the fragility of CoT monitoring as a safety mechanism.
